instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: सर्वप्रथम, गणतन्त्र दिवसको अवसरमा सम्पूर्ण नेपाली दिदीबहिनी तथा दाजुभाइमा हार्दिक शुभकामना व्यक्त गर्दछु।
target: On the occasion of the 17th Republic Day, first of all, I extend my best wishes to all Nepali brothers and sisters.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: नेपालका प्रथम शहीद लखन थापा, २००७ सालको परिवर्तन, २०४६ सालको आन्दोलन, २०५२ सालको जनयुद्ध, २०६२/६३ को जनआन्दोलन, मधेश आन्दोलन, आदिवासी जनजाति आन्दोलन लगायत सम्पूर्ण लोकतान्त्रिक आन्दोलनका महान शहीदहरूलाई हार्दिक श्रद्धाञ्जली अर्पण गर्दछु।
target: I pay my heartfelt tribute to great martyrs of all the democratic movements including Lakhan Thapa, the first martyr of Nepal, great martyrs of revolution of 1950, movement of 1990, people’s war of 1995, people’s movement of 2005/06, Madhesh movement, Adibasi Janjati movements.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: बेपत्ता परिवार, घाइते, अपांगता भएका व्यक्तिहरूसहित सबै जनसमुदायलाई उच्च सम्मान प्रकट गर्दछु।
target: I express my respect to all communities including the families of missing persons, injured and persons with disabilities.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: केही समयदेखि शिथिल रहेको मुलुकको अर्थतन्त्र सरकारको निरन्तर प्रयासबाट चलायमान हुँदै गएको छ।
target: The country's economy, which has been sluggish for some time, is becoming vibrant with the continuous efforts of the government.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: विगतमा सुरु गरेका आर्थिक सुधारका उपलब्धिहरूलाई संस्थागत गर्दै बदलिंदो विश्व अर्थव्यवस्था र नेपालको वर्तमान आवश्यकतालाई दृष्टिगत गरी अर्थतन्त्रलाई सबल र उत्प्रेरित बनाउन आवश्यक ठानेको छु।
target: I think it is necessary to institutionalise the achievements of economic reforms initiated in the past and make the economy strong and resilient in view of the changing global economy and Nepal's actual needs.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: संविधानको परिकल्पना अनुसार, राष्ट्र अर्थतन्त्रलाई आत्मनिर्भर, स्वावलम्बी तथा उत्कर्षशील बनाउँदै समाजवाद उन्मुख समृद्ध राष्ट्र निर्माणका लागि नयाँ चरणको आर्थिक सुधार आवश्यक देखिएको छ।
target: A new phase of economic reform is necessary to build a socialism-oriented prosperous nation by making the national economy self-reliant, independent and progressive as envisioned by the constitution.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: बजेटलाई आर्थिक तथा सामाजिक क्षेत्रहरूमा देखिएका चुनौतीहरूको सम्बोधन गर्दै आम नागरिकमा आत्मविश्वास र आशा जगाउने दस्तावेजको रूपमा प्रस्तुत गरेको छु।
target: I have presented the Budget as a document to instil self-confidence and hope in the common citizen by addressing the challenges witnessed in the economic and social sector.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: समृद्ध नेपाल, सुखी नेपालीको राष्ट्रिय आकांक्षा पूरा गर्न र आर्थिक सुधारका कार्यक्रम अगाडि बढाउन आगामी आर्थिक वर्षलाई आर्थिक सुधारको वर्ष घोषणा गरेको छु।
target: I have declared the next fiscal year as the year of economic reform to fulfil the national aspirations of prosperous Nepal and Happy Nepali and to carry out the program of economic reform

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: तेह्रो लगानी सम्मेलन उत्साहपूर्ण रूपमा सम्पन्न भएको छ।
target: The Third Investment Summit has been concluded with enthusiasm.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: सम्मेलनमा प्रमुख राजनीतिक दलबाट लगानीमैत्री वातावरण निर्माण गर्न र निजी क्षेत्रको आत्मबल बढाउन सामूहिक प्रतिबद्धता व्यक्त भएको छ।
target: In the summit, the majorpolitical parties expressed a collective commitment to create an investment-friendly environment and increase the confidence of the private sector.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: लगानीसम्बन्धी आठ कानूनमा एकै पटक गरिएको सुधारले सरकारको लगानीमैत्री वातावरण निर्माण गर्ने प्रतिबद्धताको पुनः पुष्टि भएको छ।
target: The government's commitment to creating an investment-friendly environment has been reaffirmed with the reform in eight laws related to investment at a time.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: मुलुकमा संघीय लोकतान्त्रिक गणतन्त्र घोषणा भएको आज सोलह वर्ष पूरा भएको छ।
target: Sixteen years have been completed today since the Federal Democratic Republic was declared in the country.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: यस अवधिमा आर्थिक तथा सामाजिक क्षेत्रमा हासिल भएका मुख्य उपलब्धिहरू प्रस्तुत गर्न अनुमति चाहन्छु।
target: Let me present the main achievements in the economic and social sectors during this period.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: आर्थिक वर्ष २०६४/६५ मा रु. ८ खर्ब १५ अर्ब रहेको कुल गार्हस्थ उत्पादन चालु आर्थिक वर्षमा रु. ५७ खर्ब ५ अर्ब हुने अनुमान छ।
target: Gross Domestic Product of the current fiscal year is estimated to be Rs. 5 trillion 705 billion which was Rs. 815 billion in the fiscal year 2007/08.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: प्रति व्यक्ति राष्ट्रिय आय अमेरिकी डलर ४९१ बाट बढेर १ हजार ४५६ पुगेको छ।
target: Per capita national income increased from US$491 to US$1,456.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: विद्युत् उत्पादन ७ सय मेगावाटबाट ३ हजार ६० मेगावाट पुगेको छ।
target: Electricity production has increased from 700 megawatts to 3,600 megawatts.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: यसबीच ५६.१ प्रतिशतबाट बढेर ९८ प्रतिशत जनसंख्यामा विद्युत् सेवाको पहुँच पुगेको छ।
target: In the meantime, the percentage of population with access to electricity services has increased from 56.1 percent to 98 percent.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: २०0८ सालमा कालोपत्रे सडक ५,४०० किलोमिटर रहेकोमा हाल १८,२४१ किलोमिटर पुगेको छ।
target: There were 5,400 km black-topped roads in the year 2008 which has now reached 18,241 km.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: ६१ जिल्ला सडक सञ्जालमा जोडिएकोमा हाल मुलुकका सबै जिल्ला राष्ट्रिय सडक सञ्जालमा जोडिएका छन्।
target: All the districts of the country are currently connected to the national road network while 61 districts were connected to the road network at that time.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: मुलुकमा सबै स्तरका गरी १ लाख ५ हजार किलोमिटर सडक रहेको छ।
target: There are 150,000 kilometers of all types of roads in the country.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: २०६५ सालमा वाणिज्य बैंकका ५ सय ९१ शाखा रहेकोमा हाल ५ हजार ४२ शाखा सञ्चालनमा रहेका छन्।
target: Currently 5,042 branches of commercial banks are in operation while there were 591 branches in 2008.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: गणतन्त्र स्थापनापछि मुलुकमा स्रोत र साधनको वितरण समानतामा उन्मुख हुँदै गएको छ।
target: After the establishment of the Republican system, the distribution of means and resources in the country is moving towards equality.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: नेपाल जीवनस्तर सर्वेक्षण २०६०/६१ मा असमानता गणना गर्दा जिनी सूचकांक ०.४१ रहेकोमा पछिल्लो सर्वेक्षणमा सुधार भई ०.३० कायम भएको छ।
target: The Gini coefficient, which calculates inequality was 0.41 in the Nepal Living Standards Survey of 2003/04, has improved to 0.30 in the latest survey.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: २०६५ सालमा निरपेक्ष गरिबी ३०.८ प्रतिशत रहेकोमा हाल घटेर २०.३ प्रतिशत पुगेको छ।
target: Absolute poverty was 30.8 percent in 2008 which has decreased to 20.3 percent.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: त्यसैगरी, मानव विकास सूचकांक ०.५०५ बाट बढेर ०.६०२ कायम भएको छ।
target: Similarly, the Human Development Index has increased from 0.505 to 0.602.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: नेपालको औसत आयु ६०.७ वर्षबाट बढेर ७१.३ वर्ष पुगेको छ।
target: The average life expectancy of Nepalis has increased from 60.7 years to 71.3 years.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: साक्षरता दर ५८ प्रतिशतबाट बढेर ७६.२ प्रतिशत पुगेको छ।
target: Literacy rate has increased from 58 percent to 76.2 percent.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: आधारभूत खानेपानीको पहुँच ४५ बाट बढेर ९७ प्रतिशत जनसंख्यामा पुगेको छ।
target: Access to basic drinking water has increased from 45 to 97 percent of the population.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: संवत् २०६४ मा शिशु मृत्यु दर प्रति हजार जीवित जन्ममा ४८ रहेकोमा हाल २१ मा झरेको छ।
target: The infant mortality rate has decreased from 48 per thousand live births in 2008 to 21 per thousand at present.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: त्यसैगरी, पाँच वर्ष मुनिको बाल मृत्यु दर प्रति हजार ६१ बाट ३३ मा र मातृ मृत्यु दर प्रति लाख २८१ बाट १५१ मा झरेको छ।
target: Similarly, the child mortality rate under five years has decreased from 61 to 33 per thousand and the maternal mortality rate has decreased from 281 to 151 per hundred thousand.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: सार्वजनिक क्षेत्रमा महिला लगायत सीमांतकृत समुदायको सहभागिता व्यापक रूपमा बढेको छ।
target: Participation of marginalized communities, including women, in the public sector has increased significantly.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: २०५६ सालको निर्वाचनमा तत्कालीन प्रतिनिधि सभामा महिलाको प्रतिनिधित्व ५.९ प्रतिशत रहेकोमा पछिल्लो निर्वाचनबाट प्रतिनिधित्व ३३.१ प्रतिशत पुगेको छ।
target: The representation of women in the House of Representatives was 5.9 percent in the 1999 election, which has reached 33.1 percent in the latest election.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: २०५४ सालमा भएको निर्वाचनबाट स्थानीय निकायमा महिलाको उपस्थिति ११.८ प्रतिशत रहेकोमा स्थानीय तहको पछिल्लो निर्वाचनबाट ४१.२ प्रतिशत पुगेको छ।
target: The representation of women in local bodies was 11.8 percent in the 1997 elections which has increased to 41.2 percent from the last local level elections.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: गणतन्त्र घोषणाको समयमा निजामती सेवामा महिलाको सहभागिता १२ प्रतिशत रहेकोमा हाल २८.५ प्रतिशत पुगेको छ।
target: Women's participation in the civil service has increased from 12 percent at the time of the declaration of the Republican system to 28.5 percent now.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: लैङ्गिक असमानता सूचकांक ०.५३२ बाट सुधार भई ०.४५२ पुगेको छ।
target: The gender inequality index has improved from 0.532 to 0.452.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: घरजग्गामा महिलाको स्वामित्व २३.९ प्रतिशत पुगेको छ।
target: Women's land ownership has reached 23.9 percent.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: यस अवधिमा महिला, आदिवासी जनजाति, मधेसी, दलित, अपांगता भएका र पछाडि परेका क्षेत्रका गरी २४ हजार १५२ व्यक्तिहरू निजामती सेवामा प्रवेश गरेका छन्।
target: During this period, 24,152 people from women, indigenous people, ethnic groups, Madhesi, Dalit, disabled and backward areas have joined the civil service.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: गणतन्त्र स्थापनापछि विभिन्न क्षेत्रमा उल्लेखनीय उपलब्धि हासिल भए तापनि हामीले अपेक्षा गरेको स्तरको विकासका लागि यी मात्र पर्याप्त छैनन्।
target: Although significant achievements have been made in various sectors since the establishment of the Republican system, these are not sufficient for the rapid development that we have expected.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: संविधान निर्माणमा लागेको लामो समय, राजनीतिक संक्रमण, भूकम्प, कोभिड-१९ जस्ता आन्तरिक र बाह्य घटनाहरूका कारण हाम्रो विकासको गति तीव्र हुन सकेन।
target: Our pace of development could not accelerate due to spending long time in drafting the constitution, internal as well as external events such as political transition, the earthquake and the Covid-19 pandemic.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: गुणस्तरीय पूर्वाधारको कमी, दक्ष जनशक्तिको न्यूनता तथा उत्पादन, उत्पादकत्व र रोजगारमा अपेक्षित वृद्धि हुन नसकेका कारण आर्थिक वृद्धिको दर न्यून हुन पुग्यो।
target: The rate of economic growth has remained low due to the lack of quality infrastructure, the shortage of skilled manpower and inability to achieve the expected increase in production, productivity and employment.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: यसबाट गरिबी र असमानतामा अपेक्षित कमी आउन नसकेको ख्याल राख्नुपर्ने देखिएको छ।
target: Food security and nutrition remained weak hindering expected reductions in poverty and inequality.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: अर्थतन्त्रमा लामो समयदेखि संरचनागत चुनौती रहेकोमा पछिल्लो समय सार्वजनिक र निजी लगानी खुम्चिएको, सार्वजनिक वित्तमा असंतुलन बढ्दै गएको, सार्वजनिक ऋण व्यवस्थापन खर्च बढ्दै गएको र पूँजीगत खर्च गर्न क्षमतामा ह्रास आएको कारण थप चुनौती सिर्जना भएको छ।
target: The long-standing structural challenges in the economy have recently been compounded by shrinking public and private investment, growing imbalances in public finances, rising public debt management costs and declining capital expenditure capacity.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: वर्षौंदेखि उस्तै प्रकृतिका समस्या तथा चुनौतीहरू दोहोरिइरहेकाले अर्थतन्त्र र विकास व्यवस्थापनमा देखिएको क्षमताको अभावको दुईचुना बोझ दरो गर्दै सुधारका नयाँ कार्यक्रममार्फत समृद्धिको लक्ष्य हासिल गर्नुपर्ने देखिएको छ।
target: In the context of witnessing the same nature of problems and challenges recurring over the years, the goal of prosperity must be achieved through a new reform program by breaking the vicious cycle of inadequate capacity witnessed in the economy and development management.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: सूचना प्रविधिमा आएको बृद्धि, कृत्रिम बौद्धिकताको बढ्दो प्रयोग र ज्ञानमा आधारित अर्थतन्त्रको विकास भइरहेको सन्दर्भमा नेपालको अर्थतन्त्रले नयाँ पुस्ता अनुकूलको आर्थिक सुधारको माग गरेको छ।
target: In the context of the revolution in information technology, the increasing use of artificial intelligence and the development of a knowledge-based economy, Nepal's economy demands economic reforms suitable for the new generation.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: युवा पुस्ताले अपेक्षा गरेअनुरूप कौशलयुक्त ज्ञान, सीप, नवप्रवर्तन र उद्यमशीलता बढाउन आवश्यक छ।
target: There is a need to develop expertise, knowledge, skills, innovation and entrepreneurship as expected by the young generation.

instruction: Translate the following English text to Nepali.
source: सन् २०२६ मा विकासोन्मुख राष्ट्रमा स्तरोन्नति भएपश्चात् लक्षणीय रणनीति, सन् २०३० सम्म दिगो विकास लक्ष्य हासिल गर्न अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय प्रतिबद्धता र मध्यम आय भएको राष्ट्रको स्तरमा पुग्ने राष्ट्रिय लक्ष्यलाई दृष्टिगत गरी आगामी आर्थिक वर्षमा आर्थिक सुधारलाई तीव्रता दिइनेछ।
target: Economic reforms will be accelerated in the coming fiscal year considering the strategy to be adopted after graduating to a developing country in 2026, the international commitment to achieve sustainable development goals by 2030, and the national goal of reaching the level of a middle-income country.
